caveats: Richmond: never use pub-richmond.escribemeetings.com - that tenant is Richmond, California; use citycouncil.richmond.ca.
Blocked to plain HTTP clients: all City of Vancouver hosts (403), West Vancouver HTML (Cloudflare 403), some portcoquitlam.ca paths, Port Moody ecalendar (403); require a real or headless browser.

JavaScript-only: District of North Vancouver site (React SPA, backend API unidentified), Electoral Area A (SharePoint; REST API available), Surrey Sliq Harmony video (API params unverified), Anmore wrapper/archive pages, and all eSCRIBE calendar UIs (use GetCalendarMeetings POST API instead).

eSCRIBE FileStream.ashx document downloads return 403 'Verifying your browser' (or 404) to curl for Burnaby, New Westminster, Lions Bay, White Rock, Delta, Langley City, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows; plan for headless-browser downloads or saved challenge cookies. Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody and Anmore FileStream behavior was not explicitly tested.

Ambiguous date semantics: eSCRIBE GetCalendarMeetings date range filters on meeting date (not posting date) - unconfirmed; Belcarra meeting dates must be parsed from PDF filenames (folder YYYY/MM is upload month); Langley Township search uses MM/DD/YYYY; Richmond and Port Coquitlam portal URLs pin a Year query param (2026 / 2023) that must be varied.

Missing/partial sources: Surrey has no Regular Council agenda archive (upcoming agendas only; Sliq may hold agendas); Lions Bay, Delta, Coquitlam and New Westminster split history across legacy archives (lionsbay.ca archive, CivicWeb, Granicus, CivicPlus AgendaCenter, publicdocs); West Vancouver video before 2024-01-15 by request only; Delta committee calendar only has events through Dec 2025.
Electoral Area A is disabled by default: it has no council; the MVRD Electoral Area Committee is the relevant body and the portal is shared across all Metro Vancouver boards, requiring filtering.
Platform values are normalized (escribe, custom, civicweb, sharepoint); legacy/secondary platforms (Granicus, CivicWeb archive, CivicPlus, Sliq, ISI) are noted in accessNotes only.
Unlinked/non-canonical hosts excluded: westvancouver.escribemeetings.com, langleycity.escribemeetings.com (staff login); non-resolving: pub-cnv, dnv, tol, langleytownship eSCRIBE hosts.

Rows link to static agenda pages (council.vancouver.ca/YYYYMMDD/*ag.htm) whose PDFs live under /YYYYMMDD/documents/. Video on Sliq Harmony (csg001-harmony.sliq.net). Pre-2001: council.vancouver.ca/previous_years/previousyears.htm.

sources.accessNotes: eSCRIBE embedded via iframe on burnaby.ca. Calendar UI needs JS; POST /MeetingsCalendarView.aspx/GetCalendarMeetings {calendarStartDate,calendarEndDate} works with curl (105 meetings Jan-Oct 2026). Meeting.aspx and FileStream.ashx return 403/404 to curl; fetch in a browser. Video also on video.isilive.ca/burnaby and YouTube.

sources.accessNotes: eSCRIBE embedded via iframe. GetCalendarMeetings POST API works with curl (90 meetings for 2026). Meeting pages and filestream.ashx PDFs return 404 to curl; use a browser. sources.accessNotes: Server-rendered ASP.NET; curl works, no JS. List URL pattern WebAgendaMinutesList.aspx?Category=<id>&Year=<yyyy> (6 = City Council; committees 4,13,17,23,24,25,27 via /meetings.htm); vary Year rather than hardcoding 2026. PDFs under /agendafiles/. Video on YouTube. Calendar takes ?Month=M&Year=YYYY. Pre-2009: /agendas/archives.htm. NEVER use pub-richmond.escribemeetings.com (Richmond, California).

sources.accessNotes: Sitecore, server-rendered; curl works. Extract PDF hrefs from the agendas page (calendarUrl): /-/media/City-of-North-Vancouver/Documents/Council-Meeting-Agenda/{YYYY}/ and .../Council-Meeting-Minutes/{YYYY}/. Prior years at .../{YYYY}-Meetings/; older minutes at /City-Hall/Council-Meetings/Council-Minutes-Archive. Video on YouTube. No eSCRIBE/CivicWeb.

sources.accessNotes: JavaScript-only React SPA (raw HTML is an empty shell); render with headless Chrome; backend API not identified. Meeting pages /government-administration/regular-meeting-YYYYMMDD list PDFs on docs.dnv.org/documents/*.pdf plus YouTube embeds. 2011-2025 archive: /government-administration/council-meeting-document-archive-20112025 (app.dnv.org/OpenDocument/Default.aspx?docNum=N).

sources.accessNotes: Drupal behind Cloudflare: HTML pages return 403 to curl; headless Chrome works.
